en.capabilities.browserBlocked: The provider does not expose a public tool ownership bridge.
en.capabilities.browserConnector: To use browser tools now, assign your own Playwright MCP connector to this Bot in Connections. It follows the existing connector approvals and data boundaries.
en.capabilities.voiceSetup: Enable Voice Input in the native Plugins page. Prepare the selected recognizer there, then use the microphone beside Send. HTTPS or loopback and microphone permission are required.
en.capabilities.voiceReady: The selected Host recognizer reports ready. Browser microphone access is checked when you record.
en.capabilities.voiceNotReady: Voice recognition is not ready. Check the native plugin settings.

zh.capabilities.browserBlocked: 提供者尚未公开工具归属桥接。
zh.capabilities.browserConnector: 如需立即使用浏览器工具，可在连接中为此 Bot 绑定自己的 Playwright MCP，沿用现有连接器审批和数据边界。
zh.capabilities.voiceSetup: 在原生插件页启用 Voice Input（语音输入），按需准备识别器，然后使用发送按钮旁的麦克风。需要 HTTPS 或本机回环地址，并授予麦克风权限。
zh.capabilities.voiceReady: 所选 Host 识别器报告已就绪；录音时仍需检查浏览器麦克风权限。
zh.capabilities.voiceNotReady: 语音识别尚未就绪，请检查原生插件设置。
